title: Oracle reinstates the CFO role, appointing Hilary Maxson after Safra Catz became principal financial officer in 2014, amid investor scrutiny over AI spending (Jaspreet Singh/Reuters)
summary: Jaspreet Singh / Reuters: Oracle reinstates the CFO role, appointing Hilary Maxson after Safra Catz became principal financial officer in 2014, amid investor scrutiny over AI spending — Oracle (ORCL.N) on Monday named Hilary Maxson as its chief financial officer, tapping an executive with deep experience in infrastructure …
